                cands.append((dt,kk,I[pi][pj]))
            cands=[c for c in cands if c[0]%2==0]

            sel=min(cands,key=lambda t:(t[0],t[1]))

import numpy as np, collections
def f(I):
    I=np.array(I); h,w=I.shape
    bgc=collections.Counter(int(x) for x in I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    P=[[bgc]*w for _ in range(h)]
    pos={'TL':(0,0),'TR':(0,w-1),'BL':(h-1,0),'BR':(h-1,w-1)}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            cands=[]
            for kk,(pi,pj) in pos.items():
                dv=max(abs(i-pi),abs(j-pj))
                cands.append((dv,kk,int(I[pi][pj])))
            mn=min(dv for dv,_,_ in cands)
            winners=[kk for dv,kk,_ in cands if dv==mn]
            good=[kk for kk in winners if int(I[pos[kk][0]][pos[kk][1]])!=bgc]
            kk=good[0] if good else winners[0]
            P[i][j]=int(I[pos[kk][0]][pos[kk][1]])
    return P
